		if (isBlank(currentStatusName)) {
			initializeStatusSubmitted();
			return;
		}

		switch (currentStatusName) {
			case STATUS_SUBMITTED:
				this.currentStatus = new Submitted();
				this.citizenEditable = true;
				break;

			case STATUS_ASSIGNED:
				this.currentStatus = new Assigned();
				this.citizenEditable = false;
				break;

				this.citizenEditable = false;
				break;

			case STATUS_RESOLVED:
				this.currentStatus = new Resolved();
				this.citizenEditable = false;
				break;

			default:
				throw new IllegalStateException(
						"Invalid current status: " + currentStatusName
				);
		}
	}

Audience: a database engineer who will change persistence to support future report-management changes.
All content comes from `src/main/java/Entity`, `Database`, `Control`, `Boundary` and `META-INF/persistence.xml`.
